scraped.scraped_description: 10 years on from PledgeBank, it should be many times easier to build a focused conditional commitment service, because today, we have services like GoCardless and Stripe, as well as things like Twillio and MailGun for messaging.

name: Beckton
tagline: A conditional-commitment tool for creating groups of paying members — only charges if enough people join.
sdg_alignment: SDG 8 - Decent Work and Economic Growth
dependency_risks: abandoned prototype — no active development since ~2019
documented_limitations: prototype only — not finished or production-deployed
author notes it was 'never quite finished'
political_relevance_summary: Addresses challenges in civic technology infrastructure by serving trade unions, membership organisations, civic groups.

movement_building_utility.notes: Open-source infrastructure that enables others to build or deploy civic technology solutions.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication and adaptation. Could be adapted for other national contexts with localization effort.
